steps.title: Configure run parameters
steps.instruction: Set the following parameters before starting: number of samples (1‑96), reaction volume (µL) for the first plate, bead‑to‑sample ratio (default 1.8), elution volume (µL), P300 multi‑channel mount side (the single‑channel P300 defaults to the opposite side), well‑plate type (BioRad 96‑well or Greiner 96‑well with circular wells), and flash option (whether the robot flashes on pauses). Prepare the magnetic beads either neat from the bottle or diluted in a 40 % PEG 8000 solution. Use P300 single‑channel and multi‑channel pipettes with 4‑in‑1 tube racks or 12‑well reservoirs as needed.

steps.title: Add and mix beads
steps.instruction: Add magnetic beads to each well of the sample plate according to the specified bead‑to‑sample ratio. Mix the sample/bead mixture thoroughly. Re‑mix the bead reservoir after every three samples to keep the bead suspension homogeneous.

substeps.instruction: Add beads based on bead ratio
Re‑mix bead reservoir after each set of three samples

steps.title: Incubate beads and engage magnet
steps.instruction: Incubate the bead‑bound samples for 10 minutes. Then engage the magnetic module for 7 minutes to collect the beads against the well wall.

steps.title: Remove supernatant
steps.instruction: Aspirate the supernatant from each well and dispense it into the waste container located in slot 11.

steps.title: First ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Add ethanol to each well (200 µL for Greiner plates, 120 µL for BioRad plates). Wait 2 minutes to allow beads to re‑pellet, then remove the ethanol and discard it in the waste container in slot 11.

substeps.instruction: Add ethanol (200 µL Greiner or 120 µL BioRad)

steps.title: Second ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Repeat the ethanol wash: add the same volume of ethanol as in the first wash, incubate 2 minutes, and remove the ethanol to the waste container in slot 11.

steps.title: Add water and mix
steps.instruction: Add the elution water (volume defined by the elution volume parameter) to each well and mix to resuspend the beads.

steps.title: Elution incubation and magnetic capture
steps.instruction: Incubate the mixture for 5 minutes to allow nucleic acid elution, then engage the magnetic module for 7 minutes to separate beads from the eluate.

steps.title: Transfer eluate
steps.instruction: Aspirate the eluate, now free of beads, and dispense it into the destination plate located in slot 10.
